title: Person shot inside McDonald's restaurant near school in Humble, police say
text:
Person shot inside McDonald's restaurant near school in Humble, police say - ABC13 Houston

 Person shot inside McDonald's restaurant near school in Humble, police say 
 Police are investigating a shooting that happened inside the McDonald's restaurant in Humble on Wednesday. By Luke Jones Thursday, November 19, 2026 4:11AM Share HUMBLE, Texas (KTRK) -- Police are investigating a shooting that happened inside the McDonald's restaurant in Humble on Wednesday.
 According to the Humble Police Department, the shooting happened inside the McDonald's restaurant at Will Clayton Parkway near Wilson Road. Police said that a young male shot another young male. The victim is expected to survive, according to police.
 According to the Humble Independent School District, officers said they were notified shortly after 4 p.m. due to a shooting near the school campus.

 According to the district, law enforcement apprehended the suspect they were seeking in the area and advised school officials at 4:16 p.m. that normal operations could resume.
 No additional information about the shooting, suspect, or the victim's identity was immediately released.
